groups.activity: The Duviri Experience, Kullervo then the Orowyrm
conditions: Bane pays out only if the Kullervo boss and the Orowyrm both die in the same run; killing Kullervo and leaving gives nothing
Kullervo's Hold does not exist during Joy or Envy, so two of the five 2-hour mood windows are dead time
Steel Path pays 6-8 Bane a run instead of 4-6, but the longer run costs more than the extra Bane is worth
Run The Duviri Experience, not The Lone Story; the Hold is a side objective only in the Experience
If The Warden is not above the arena the fight is scheduled as a later main objective, so do not wait for him
Pathos Clamps are immune to Resource Boosters
bonuses: Ueymag for both the Chassis and the Systems comes off these same runs
Resources are kept once you earn a Decree, so an abandoned run still keeps the pickups
The Orowyrm that ends every Bane run drops all 10 Pathos Clamps in one kill

disclosures.title: how to beat Kullervo
disclosures.body: Three sequential health bars, fought as the Drifter. Primaries do half damage and secondaries two thirds, but finishers do 1.1x, so melee and finishers are the way through. Phase 1 is Collective Curse and the Storm of Ukko knife rain, which a precise Sirocco shot interrupts; phase 2 spawns five blade-throwing copies; phase 3 spawns Persecutor Liminus, and killing them all turns them on Kullervo before his aerial laser barrages, best dodged from a Kaithe. Bring at least 5 Decrees before speaking to The Warden, and Transference Sync to a modded Warframe if it goes badly.

disclosures.title: why public squads go wrong
disclosures.body: Squads farm decrees for 40+ minutes before touching an objective, refuse the Undercroft, and stall on Orowyrm mechanics; one reported run hit 50 minutes and collapsed. Solo, Alchemy and Void Flood take 2-3 minutes each, while the same Alchemy bar crawls with 3-4 players.

disclosures.title: climbing the Orowyrm
disclosures.body: It has no traversal animation, so climbing looks broken: jump off and re-grapple repeatedly to move up the segments. The telegraphed energy ring on a ~30 second cycle knocks you off, so hop off and re-grapple through it. Wyrmlings do not need a Kaithe; step outside the ring of fire or wall-latch and shoot them.
